description: Source code implementing shell commands for Bluetooth Mesh Device Firmware Distribution (DFD) management, including receiver management, firmware handling, and DFD process control.

methods.name: print_receivers_status
methods.description: Prints the status of DFD receivers including status code and target count.

methods.name: print_dfd_status
methods.description: Prints the current DFD status including phase, group, app index, TTL, timeout, transfer mode, apply flag, and slot index.

methods.name: print_fw_status
methods.description: Prints firmware status including slot index, firmware ID, and status.

methods.name: slot_space_cb
methods.description: Callback to accumulate total size of firmware slots for slot space calculation.

methods.name: cmd_dfd_receivers_add
methods.description: Adds receivers to the DFD service based on input string of addresses and firmware indices.

methods.name: cmd_dfd_receivers_delete_all
methods.description: Deletes all receivers from the DFD service.

methods.name: cmd_dfd_receivers_get
methods.description: Retrieves and displays a list of target receivers with their statuses.

methods.name: cmd_dfd_capabilities_get
methods.description: Displays DFD capabilities such as max targets, slot count, max slot size, slot space, and remaining space.

methods.name: cmd_dfd_start
methods.description: Starts a DFD process with specified parameters.

methods.name: cmd_dfd_fw_get
methods.description: Retrieves firmware information by firmware ID.

methods.name: cmd_dfd_fw_get_by_idx
methods.description: Retrieves firmware information by slot index.
